text: Identify any unusually high time. Would it be an outlier under the 1.5 × IQR rule? Explain.
html:
RunnerTimes (minutes)
Damien20, 22, 30, 21, 28, 22
Brett22, 19, 25, 24, 18, 32

Identify any unusually high time. Would it be an outlier under the 1.5 × IQR rule? Explain.
answerHtml:
Worked solution

Brett’s 32 minutes is relatively high and the source key calls it an outlier. Using median-of-halves quartiles, Brett has Q1=19, Q3=25, IQR=6 and upper fence 34, so 32 is not a formal 1.5 × IQR outlier. Damien has Q1=21, Q3=28 and fences 10.5 and 38.5, so neither runner has a formal outlier.
